title: ci: publish examples/app-starter to the cloud marketplaces as the first-party starter
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6v5QuqVF4wwLSEXGDS8Cp1)_

Fixes #38024
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwGtpcNepn9p8wrMNo

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 加了两条流程，把起步应用（`com.example.starter`）作为第一方起步包发布到 cloud 市场：staging 在每次发版时自动发，也可以手动触发；生产只能手动触发，且默认是干跑。
- 合并后，cloud#5149 的"新工作区首个环境首次打开时自动安装起步应用"才有包可装。
- **需要你做的有三件**：
  1. 确认组织密钥 `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY_STAGING` / `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY_PRODUCTION` 对本仓可见，必须是平台管理员的 key。本会话读不到密钥设置；没配时流程会直接失败并报出密钥名，不会静默跳过。
  2. 合并后先手动触发 staging，选干跑看 payload，再选正式发布。
  3. 生产要不要发、什么时候发，由你决定。
- 风险：main 现在处在预发布模式，发出去的版本号是 `0.1.1-next.1` 这种形式。cloud 是否把它当作"已批准版本"，本会话核实不了（读不到 cloud 仓）。staging 第一次跑完请按卡面验收条件看一下 `GET /api/v1/cloud/packages`。
- 这是 Tier H（新工作流、引用密钥），由你手动合并。

## What changes
- **`scripts/ci/publish-starter-marketplace.mjs`** (new): publishes `examples/app-starter` as THE first-party starter. Before any request, a dry run included, it refuses an artifact that is missing, does not parse, carries no objects, or whose manifest id is not `com.example.starter`. Outside a dry run it also refuses an empty `OS_CLOUD_URL` / `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, naming the workflow secret. It then sends:
  1. `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages`: `manifest_id: com.example.starter`, `visibility: marketplace`, `is_starter: true`, `publisher: objectstack`, `display_name`, `description`, `namespace`, `license`, `readme` (the starter's README.md), `icon_url` (the platform logo). **No `owner_org_id`**: a service-mode caller naming no owner mints the first-party row.
  2. `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages/:id/versions`: `{ version, bundle, auto_approve: true }`. A 409 (the version exists) is a no-op with exit 0. A 422 prints the marketplace policy violations. A version that comes back with a `listing_status` other than `approved` fails the run, because the cloud counts only an approved version as the starter.
  - `Authorization: Bearer $OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, a per-request timeout (`OS_CLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 240 s, because the control plane can be cold), and up to 4 attempts with 3/6/12 s backoff on a timeout, a network error or a 5xx. The shape is HotCRM's `scripts/publish-marketplace.mjs`.
  - Why not `os package publish`: the CLI never sends `is_starter` (`isStarter` is in `RETIRED_INERT_MANIFEST_KEYS`, because the flag is the platform's to decide). This first-party publish is the platform deciding, so it sends the flag from its own payload, as HotCRM does for its own constants.
  - `--self-test`: 15 table-driven batteries against a fake control plane. It uses the roster, floor and verdict-handshake shape of `check-agent-model-declared.mjs`, and is wired into lint.yml's "Moved workflow step bodies self-test" collector, because the publish step itself fires on no PR event.
- **`.github/workflows/publish-starter-staging.yml`** (new): `https://cloud.objectos.app`, `secrets.OS_CLOUD_API_KEY_STAGING`. It triggers on a push to `main` that changes `examples/app-starter/package.json`, and on `workflow_dispatch` with a `dry_run` input (default on).
- **`.github/workflows/publish-starter-production.yml`** (new): `https://cloud.objectos.ai`, `secrets.OS_CLOUD_API_KEY_PRODUCTION`, **`workflow_dispatch` only** with `dry_run` (default on).
  - Both workflows: checkout, `./.github/actions/setup-workspace`, `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-starter`, then the script. They set `permissions: contents: read`, a per-plane concurrency group without cancellation, `timeout-minutes: 30`, and `if: github.repository == 'objectstack-ai/objectstack'`.
- **`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`**: both new workflows are added to `WORKFLOW_TIER_H_FILES` (Tier H by path, like `docker-publish.yml`), and its self-test pin of that list is updated. This row is ruling-sized by that list's own docblock, so the maintainer's merge is the ruling.

## Why
objectstack-ai/cloud#5149 makes a new workspace's first environment install the platform starter on first open. It counts one row only: `com.example.starter`, `is_starter: true`, no owner, `marketplace`, an approved version. Nothing published that row, so the cloud path did nothing. Measured on `origin/main` f72f3353: no workflow or script under `.github/` or `scripts/` posts to the cloud marketplace.

## Decisions for the maintainer (seat rulings, each yours to change)
1. **Trigger.** A tag trigger cannot fire in this repo: `release.yml` pushes the version tags with `GITHUB_TOKEN` (the publish step's `git push origin --tags`), and nothing `GITHUB_TOKEN` pushes starts a workflow. The starter is also a private package, and changesets never tag those (`privatePackages.tag: false`). Staging therefore runs on the push that lands the Version Packages PR, which rewrites the starter's `package.json` on every release, plus `workflow_dispatch`. Production is dispatch only.
2. **Version.** The published version is `examples/app-starter/package.json`'s, which changesets bump every release. The manifest's own `version: '0.1.0'` is hand-kept and has never moved, so publishing it would answer 409 forever and leave every later change unpublished. The script sets the artifact's `manifest.version` to the published version, and says so in the log, so the stored bundle and its version row agree. **Risk:** while `main` is in prerelease mode the version is `0.1.1-next.N`. Whether the cloud accepts a prerelease as the starter's approved version could not be read from here (the cloud repo is out of this session's scope), so please dry-run staging first, then publish, then check acceptance.
3. **Listing.** The text is the README only, with no invented copy, tags, taxonomy facets or translations. The icon is the platform logo (`apps/docs/public/logo.svg` on `main`). This goes beyond "readme only" on purpose: `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` says the marketplace refuses a listing with no README or no icon, and the logo is an existing asset, not new copy. The README is written for developers (it lists `src/` directories). A customer-facing listing text is follow-up work if you want one.
4. **Secrets.** Not measured: this session's proxy refuses the actions secrets API (HTTP 403). The workflows read `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY_STAGING` / `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY_PRODUCTION`, the names HotCRM's publish workflows use. If those org secrets do not list this repository, add it to their repository access, or create repository secrets with the same names. The key must be a platform-admin key (for `auto_approve`).

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `scripts/ci/publish-starter-marketplace.mjs`: `packageBody` (no `owner_org_id`), `publish()` (refusals before any request, 409, the approved check).
2. The two workflows: triggers, secrets, the `--dry-run` expression.
3. The `WORKFLOW_TIER_H_FILES` rows and their pin.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/ci/publish-starter-marketplace.mjs --self-test` prints 15 passing cases. After `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-starter`, `node scripts/ci/publish-starter-marketplace.mjs --dry-run` prints both payloads and makes no request.

<details><summary>Readings at e05f80f4 (base origin/main f72f3353)</summary>

- Premise at f72f3353: `git grep -nE 'api/v1/cloud/packages|OS_CLOUD_API_KEY|cloud\.objectos\.(app|ai)|is_starter' -- .github scripts` gave 3 hits, all noise (two issue-template dropdown options and one comment in `check-cli-examples-parity.mjs`). `git grep -nE 'examples/app-starter|example-starter' -- .github` gave 0.
- Build: `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-starter` (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, cold) ran 71 tasks in 65 s, exit 0. Artifact `dist/objectstack.json` is 29.6 KB: objects 2, apps 1, views 2, dashboards 1, datasets 2, data 2, translations 1; `manifest.id` `com.example.starter`, `manifest.version` `0.1.0`.
- `node scripts/ci/publish-starter-marketplace.mjs --dry-run` on that artifact: exit 0, no request, `version 0.1.1-next.1` (stamped from 0.1.0), package body with `is_starter: true`, `visibility: marketplace`, no `owner_org_id`; version body `auto_approve: true`.
- `--self-test`: 15 cases pass. Ablation on the committed file, restored each time with `git checkout HEAD --` (`git status --porcelain` empty afterwards): `is_starter: false` gave 2 failures; an added `owner_org_id` gave 3; the 409 branch disabled gave 1; `auto_approve` dropped gave 2; the empty-key refusal disabled gave 1.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at e05f80f4: 82 derived, 82 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun. `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (could not measure: `@objectstack/service-print` had no build output in the worktree). It exited 0 after the prerequisite build it names ("OK (15 config(s), 577 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)").
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two changed `.mjs` files: exit 0.
- Advisory CI timing (AGENTS: a PR that changes CI reports the affected job): the lint.yml collector gains one sub-second self-test (0.13 s locally). The two new workflows run on no PR event.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- After the merge and a staging run: staging's `GET /api/v1/cloud/packages` lists `com.example.starter` with `is_starter: true`, owner null and an approved version, and a new staging workspace's first environment installs it on first open (the card's acceptance; the maintainer's run).
- The production run is the maintainer's call.
- No changeset: nothing here publishes npm bytes (`examples/app-starter` is private and unchanged).

## Human Minimum
- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing to npm; both lines are above.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
